verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs whatever Docker image you give it as a hardware-isolated VM placed close to users, and it generates Dockerfiles for Node apps. That means Node.js code runs on a full Linux runtime rather than a restricted edge-function subset. Machines boot in under a second and scale out, giving serverless-like elasticity. missing for 10: explicit documentation that arbitrary npm packages (including native modules) run unmodified, a function-style (per-request) invocation model rather than app/VM deployment, and independent hands-on corroboration of Node workloads at the edge.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run unmodified Node.js code and npm packages in edge/serverless functions instead of a restricted runtime subset

citations.quote: Fly.io converts Docker images to fast-booting VMs and runs them globally.
No Dockerfile? No problem: we'll generate one for most popular frameworks, including Rails, Phoenix, Django, Node, Laravel, Go, Rust, .NET and more.
Fly Machines are hardware-isolated VMs that boot in under a second, run close to your users, and scale out to tens of thousands when the traffic arrives.
We build Machines out of the images you give us and we run them where you tell us to.
